entry.author: City Rail Link
entry.summary:
Tēnā koe,
In this month’s newsletter, Dinko from Link Alliance showcases the new hearing loops installed across our stations, which improve accessibility for all passengers who use hearing aids and assistive listening devices.
 
Arunee from Auckland Council discusses how the surrounding station precinct neighbourhoods are taking shape.
 
Finally, KiwiRail provides an update on the testing underway in Drury, as work continues across the wider rail network to prepare for passenger services in the second half of 2026.
